items.statement: Under the submitted consistent gas-phase protocol, cis-alpha and cis-beta are compared as named stationary points and cis-alpha is the lower-electronic-energy reference isomer; the result supports a relative-stability distinction but does not by itself establish kinetics or solution thermodynamics.
